WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT mt.Name AS media_type_name,
         AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
         AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY mt.Name
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM step1
)
SELECT s1.media_type_name,
       s1.avg_unit_price,
       s1.avg_bytes_per_ms,
       s1.avg_bytes_per_ms / s2.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms
FROM step1 AS s1
CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2
WHERE s2.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL
